about.headline: Missing one task on site easily costs an extra NT$3000 day-rate. If materials are wasted it hurts even more — those misses become pure overhead.

experence.title: Give interior teams a clear, calm record of every job site
experence.description: From capturing updates to sharing them instantly, every milestone stays transparent so the whole crew reacts fast.

testimonials.quote1: I can prioritize each site in minutes — it's like having a personal assistant.
testimonials.quote2: With KaiJi, our record rhythm stays smooth and every update is instantly clear.

feature.title: Plan smoothly, execute faster

services.description1: Rearrange tasks freely so the plan always matches the job site reality
services.description2: Mark to-dos directly on floor plans so documentation stays intuitive

meta.title: SitePhoto｜You donate, I shoot
meta.description: A charity interior photography project in Taipei. Donate to a good cause — I'll photograph your space.

hero.subtitle: You donate. I photograph.
hero.description: Redirect your photography budget to charity — SitePhoto turns your space into a lasting portfolio.
hero.note: 15 charity slots per year / Taipei City only

works.behanceNote: New work is published on Behance — head there for the complete portfolio.

story.p1: The homeowner moves into their dream home; the designer completes a work to be proud of.
story.p2: I kept wondering — could this happiness reach a little further?
story.p3: So this project was born: designers donate the photography budget to a charity, and I do the shooting.
story.p4: So that finishing one home can do a little good for many more people.
story.closing: You donate, I photograph — a home's happiness keeps flowing.

plans.intro: No photography fee — once your slot is confirmed, donate directly to a charity.
plans.footnote: For spaces over ~200㎡, special venues, or commercial commissions, please enquire separately. Deliverables and dates are confirmed case by case.
plans.warning: Apply first, and donate only after your slot is confirmed — not before.

apply.description: Fill in a few details — I'll reply by email to confirm fit and available dates.
apply.notice: Charity photography is limited to Taipei City.
apply.detailsPlaceholder: e.g. ~92㎡ apartment finishing in December — Google Drive links welcome
apply.disclaimer: An application doesn't guarantee a booking — I'll share next steps after confirming availability.

thanks.title: Application submitted!
thanks.p1: Thanks for supporting SitePhoto. I'll reply by email with the shoot terms and available dates.
thanks.p2: Your booking isn't confirmed yet — please don't donate just yet.

projects.title: How to kick off a project
projects.description: Upload your Excel Gantt plan and KaiJi instantly converts it into an editable schedule so you can tweak progress while comparing design and onsite timelines.

tasks.title: Create and monitor tasks
tasks.description: Inside each project, add construction to-dos, arrange sequences by trade, and set reminders plus material notes.

drawing.title: Annotate tasks directly on drawings
drawing.description: Walk the site and pin tasks to their real-world locations, including multiple markers for the same task when needed.

share.title: Share progress and updates
share.description: Synchronize every stakeholder through cloud sharing so jobsite progress stays transparent in real time.
